description: E3b arm A -- refinement at 6 blocks

config.augmentation: random crop, per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1, no flip
config.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=200 -- FROZEN at the 200-epoch value and deliberately NOT re-fitted to the 30-epoch budget, so this run is a strict prefix of the 200-epoch run it screens for
config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity
config.hypothesis: A refinement stack trained at 6 residual blocks matches six-block H2 at the same budget, seed and recipe, and stays stereo-functional.
config.changed_variable: number of residual blocks in Refinement.blocks (6 instead of 6); trailing dilation-1 blocks removed, the 1-2-4-8 ladder kept intact
config.control: the seed-0 records, READ-ONLY and NOT retrained: Stage B deterministic run A (6 blocks) and EXP-BLOCKCOUNT-DETERMINISTIC-001 arms B/C (5/4 blocks)
config.validation_protocol: first 10 scenes of hailo_val, full 368x1232 frames, pooled over gt > 0 (exp_h1_cost_volume.validate, imported); every 5 epochs, plus epochs 1 and 2
config.known_limitation: 160 training scenes from random initialisation: a capacity result here does NOT transfer to a pretrained model. MACs are arithmetic, not latency (Phase 1 measured 0.67x-142x misprediction on this stack). One seed in stage 1; no significance test and none claimed.
config.experiment_kind: CHEAP 30-EPOCH SEED/TRAJECTORY SCREEN. NOT the block-count experiment and NOT a capacity measurement. Its only job is to decide whether a full multi-seed 200-epoch block-count experiment is justified.
config.materiality_band: NONE. The historical E3b/E3c band is invalidated. No band is reused and none is invented here, before or after seeing the results.
config.claim_ceiling: A 30-epoch screen CANNOT establish the 200-epoch capacity ranking. No statement of the form 'N blocks are required/equivalent/superior' is supportable outside the phrase 'in the 30-epoch screen'.
